3700.name: Landfall On The Island Of The Dead

east.description: To the east lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies On a strong east-west current.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

3700.description:
A narrow strip of grey shingle is the island's only landing, where a gap
in a row of rotted stakes lets a boat nose in from the water to the
south. Dead trees lean over the tideline, and tilted stones mark the
grass above it. Mist drifts off the sea and settles cold on your
clothes. The shore runs away east and west, both ways fading into the
whiteness.

3701.name: Along The Southern Island Shore

east.description: To the east lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

west.description: To the west lies Landfall On The Island Of The Dead.

3701.description:
The shingle gives way to coarse grass and flat grey pebbles, and the sea
breathes slowly against the stones. Nothing cries on this coast; the
only sound is the drip of mist from a driftwood spar propped upright in
the sand. The shore goes on east toward a pale cairn, and west back to
the landing.

3702.name: Along The Southern Island Shore

east.description: To the east lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

3702.description:
A cairn of pale stones stands waist-high above the tideline, each one
laid with care and none of them carrying a name. Behind it the island
rises into a wall of bare black trees that hold the mist like wool. The
grass is flattened and silvered with damp, and the shore continues east
and west along the same low line.

3703.name: Along The Southern Island Shore

east.description: To the east lies Following The Curving Shore.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

3703.description:
Here the shore begins to lean away, the shingle narrowing between the
dull water and a bank of tangled brambles. A great curved rib of some
long-drowned beast lies bleached on the stones. The sea hushes in and
out, in and out. East the strand bends round a corner of the island, and
west it runs straight back toward the landing.

3704.name: Following The Curving Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

3704.description:
The shore turns a corner here, the sea wrapping round the island's edge
and the strand bending with it. Rushes hiss in the wind off the water,
and small flat stones lie in neat rows as though someone once sorted
them by weight. The shore runs on north along a steadier line, while the
way west returns along the shingle.

3705.name: Along The Eastern Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Following The Curving Shore.

3705.description:
A long grey beach stretches ahead, empty but for ribbons of black kelp
and the splintered keel of a boat that no one ever came back for. The
mist is thick enough to taste, cold and faintly of iron. Behind you the
shore bends back south toward the corner, and it carries on north into
the whiteness.

3706.name: Along The Eastern Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

3706.description:
A standing stone as tall as a man stands on the dry sand just above the
waves, its face worn smooth by salt. Something is cut into it, a pair of
scales and a single feather, though the sea wind has softened the lines.
The grass about its foot is trodden flat. The shore runs south and north
past it.

extra_descs.stone standing scales feather:
The carving shows a pair of balanced scales, and on one pan a single
feather no bigger than your thumb. The sea wind has worn the lines
nearly smooth, but whoever cut them was careful.

3707.name: Along The Eastern Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

3707.description:
Tidal pools glisten among the rocks here, each one still and dark as an
eye. A scatter of grey feathers lies in the wrack, wet and matted, and
the wind turns them over without ever lifting them. Dead trees crowd
close behind the strand, hung with strands of mist. The shore goes on
north and south.

3708.name: Along The Eastern Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

3708.description:
A single gnarled yew leans out over the sand, its trunk split and
hollow, its bark gone the colour of old ash. Under it the ground is dry
and bare, and the sound of the sea seems oddly far off. Past the tree
the shore is a thin pale ribbon running north, and it runs back south
the way you came.

3709.name: Along The Eastern Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

3709.description:
A rusted anchor lies half sunk in the shingle, its chain trailing down
into the surf like something that gave up pulling. The breakers come in
long and slow and break without foam. Ahead the shore curves faintly
toward the trees, and the mist presses so close that the next stretch of
beach seems a rumour. You can go north or south.

3710.name: Along The Eastern Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Following The Curving Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

3710.description:
Dark sand drifts up here into low dunes, held together by pale clumps of
sea grass that rattle softly in the breeze. Wet footprints would last no
time in this light, and you see none. The shore keeps to the water's
edge, running south toward the anchor and north toward a sharper bend.

3711.name: Following The Curving Shore

south.description: To the south lies Along The Eastern Island Shore.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Northern Island Shore.

3711.description:
The island's edge turns again here, and the surf curls round it in a
long grey arc. Black rocks stand out of the shallows like the knuckles
of a buried hand, and the tide mutters in the gaps between them. The way
back south follows the beach, while west the shore sweeps on along the
island's far side.

3712.name: Along The Northern Island Shore

east.description: To the east lies Following The Curving Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Following A Stream In The Dense Forest.

3712.description:
A narrow stream tumbles over the shingle and loses itself in the sea,
cutting a dark channel through the pale stones. Where it comes from, the
forest begins in earnest, a thick dark wall of oak and hornbeam leaning
together. A faint trail follows the stream into the trees to the south,
and the shore stretches east round the curve.

3713.name: Along The Southern Island Shore

east.description: To the east lies Landfall On The Island Of The Dead.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

3713.description:
The shingle is firm and pale here, and out in the shallows to the east
you can make out the line of rotted stakes that guards the landing. A
cold stillness lies over the water, and the dead trees on the bank are
hung with drifting mist. The shore leads east to the landing and west
along the island's edge.

3714.name: Along The Southern Island Shore

east.description: To the east lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

3714.description:
Flotsam has collected in a long drift along the tideline: splintered
planks, a cracked oar, cork floats gone black, a tangle of rope. None of
it looks to have been touched in years. The grey sea slaps and
withdraws. The shore runs on east and west.

3715.name: Along The Southern Island Shore

east.description: To the east lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

west.description: To the west lies Following The Curving Shore.

3715.description:
A band of tall pale reeds grows thick along the strand here, whispering
whenever the air stirs. Between the stems the sand is dark and firm,
scored by the shallow furrows of an old dragged keel. The mist gathers
beyond the reeds into a solid wall. The shore leads east toward the
landing, and west toward a ruined shed.

3716.name: Following The Curving Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Western Island Shore.

east.description: To the east lies Along The Southern Island Shore.

3716.description:
The remains of a long boathouse crouch at the water's edge, its roof
half fallen in and its timbers grey as driftwood. Slimy stone ramps
slope down from its open mouth into the shallows. Inside, only damp and
shadow. The strand runs on east along the water, and the shore goes back
north past the ruin.

3717.name: Along The Western Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Western Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Following The Curving Shore.

3717.description:
A stone cross, taller than you, leans against the wind at the top of the
beach, its arms worn to stumps. At its foot someone has set a ring of
white pebbles, and the grass inside the ring is greener than the rest.
The shore curves south toward a low roofed ruin, and runs back north the
way you came.

extra_descs.cross stone pebbles:
The cross is worn so smooth that no carving remains, only a faint shadow
where an inscription once ran. The pebbles in the ring at its foot are
all white and all the same size.

3718.name: Along The Western Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Western Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Western Island Shore.

3718.description:
Here the sea has eaten into the edge of the island, leaving the pale
roots of drowned trees thrust up through the sand like bones. The ground
is soft, and a faint sour smell of rot lies in the mist. A line of thin
grey weed marks the highest tide. North and south the shore runs on.

3719.name: Along The Western Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Western Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Western Island Shore.

3719.description:
Great flat slabs of grey slate run down to the water in terraces, slick
with spray and green at the edges. Pools collect in their hollows and
hold still reflections of the sky. The trees behind are bent permanently
toward the land by old storms. The shore continues north and south.

3720.name: Along The Western Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Western Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Western Island Shore.

3720.description:
A tall spike of rock stands offshore, wearing a cap of pale guano and a
skirt of weed, and the surf breaks around it in lazy lines. On the dry
sand lies a long scatter of white cuttlebone and driftwood. A low murmur
comes from the water, like many people whispering. The shore runs on
north and south.

3721.name: Along The Western Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along The Western Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Western Island Shore.

3721.description:
Black pilings stand out of the shallows here in a crooked row, the
stumps of a jetty that must once have reached far out. No gull calls
here, and only the wash of small waves breaks the silence. The grass
behind the strand is tall and silver. You can follow the shore north or
south.

3722.name: Along The Western Island Shore

north.description: To the north lies Following The Curving Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Western Island Shore.

3722.description:
A line of rotted stakes stands in the sand, still festooned with the
shreds of an old net that hangs like grey cobweb. Beyond them a skein of
mist lies on the water, motionless. The tide has left a perfect line of
small shells along the shingle. The shore runs on south, and curves back
north toward a rocky point.

3723.name: Following The Curving Shore

east.description: To the east lies Along The Northern Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Western Island Shore.

3723.description:
The island's edge turns another corner here, and black rocks run out
into the surf like a broken causeway. Thick weed drapes them, and the
water sucks and gurgles in the gaps. The wind off the sea has a taste of
old brine. East the sand returns toward the forest edge, and the shore
sweeps south along the water.

3724.name: Along The Northern Island Shore

south.description: To the south lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

west.description: To the west lies Following The Curving Shore.

3724.description:
The forest path spills out onto a bank of pale sand where the tree line
ends in a ragged edge. Beyond lies the grey water, flat and wide, its
far side lost in mist. A few bleached logs have been thrown up on the
sand, rolled smooth by the waves. The trail leads south back into the
trees, and the shore bends away west.

3725.name: Following A Stream In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies Along The Northern Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Following A Stream In The Dense Forest.

3725.description:
The stream runs clear and cold beside you, talking to itself among the
roots of ancient oaks. Overhead the leaves are so thick that the mist
comes down only in threads, silvering the ferns. The ground is soft and
black with old leaf-fall, and a trodden line follows the water. North
the trees open toward the grey sea, and south the stream winds deeper
in.

3726.name: Following A Stream In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies Following A Stream In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies Following A Stream In The Dense Forest.

3726.description:
The forest closes in here, hornbeam and holly crowding the bank until
the water has to push between them. Moss grows thick on every north-
facing trunk, but nothing stirs in the branches overhead. The path is a
muddy ribbon beside the stream, and it carries on north toward the light
and south into the shadows.

3727.name: Following A Stream In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies Following A Stream In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies Crossing A Stream In The Dense Forest.

3727.description:
The trees lean together over the water and form a low green roof,
through which the grey sky shows in coins. A fallen alder lies across
part of the stream and has gathered a drift of pale leaves. The air
smells of wet earth and something older, like stone cellars. The path
follows the stream north and south.

3728.name: Crossing A Stream In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies Following A Stream In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies Following A Stream In The Dense Forest.

3728.description:
A line of flat stepping stones crosses the stream here, each one worn
into a shallow dish by passing feet. The water runs quick and brown
between them, and its chatter is the only sound in the wood. Either side
the forest is dense and dark, and the path picks up again north and
south of the crossing.

3729.name: Following A Stream In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies Crossing A Stream In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies At A Turn On The Forest Path.

3729.description:
The stream slackens and widens into a still brown pool among the roots,
and a few dead leaves turn on its surface. Bracken stands waist-high on
the bank, beaded with moisture. The wood presses in from all sides, but
the trail is clear enough, running north back along the water and south
to where it bends away from it.

3730.name: At A Turn On The Forest Path

north.description: To the north lies Following A Stream In The Dense Forest.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

3730.description:
The trail leaves the stream and makes a sharp turn among thick-boled
oaks, as if bending round something that was once there. Roots break the
ground in knuckles, and a lichen like grey hair hangs from the lowest
boughs. The path runs north back toward the stream and west deeper into
the forest.

3731.name: On A Path In The Dense Forest

east.description: To the east lies At A Turn On The Forest Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Clearing.

3731.description:
A path of beaten earth winds between close-set trunks, the way marked by
a few flat stones that someone laid long ago. Dead branches creak above
you though no wind reaches this far in. The light is a dim green-grey,
and the smell of leaf mould lies heavy. The path goes east toward the
turn and west toward a lighter place.

3732.name: A Small Clearing

east.description: To the east lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

west.description: To the west lies Standing Before The Ruined Necropolis.

3732.description:
The trees step back and leave a small round clearing, floored with short
pale grass and ringed by silent trunks. At its edge a low wall of fitted
stone is half swallowed by ivy, and the ground feels hushed, as though
the air itself were listening. A path runs back east into the forest,
and west the stonework thickens toward the ruin ahead.

3733.name: On A Path In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies Along The Northern Island Shore.

south.description: To the south lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

3733.description:
The forest begins to thin here, the trunks growing slimmer and farther
apart, and a cool wind carrying salt comes in from beyond the trees. The
path is sandy and pale, bordered by wiry bent grass. Through the last of
the trunks to the north the sky opens wide and grey over the water, and
the trail leads south back into the dense wood.

3734.name: On A Path In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

3734.description:
The path climbs a few paces over a low swell of ground, rooted with
ancient knotted oak. At the top the trees thin a little and the sky
shows through as a pale grey patch. A scatter of black feathers lies in
the dirt, long dry and brittle. The trail leads north toward lighter air
and south back into the dark.

3735.name: On A Path In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

3735.description:
A pair of tall beeches arch over the path, their smooth grey trunks
marked with old, healed scars where names might once have been cut.
Fallen mast crunches softly underfoot. The air is cooler here and
somehow expectant. You can follow the track north or south.

3736.name: On A Path In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

3736.description:
A line of stunted thorn trees follows the trail here, each one bent the
same way by a wind that you cannot feel. The ground between them is bare
and hard, as if swept. Mist hangs at knee height. The path goes on north
and south through the thorns.

3737.name: On A Path In The Dense Forest

north.description: To the north lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies At A Turn On The Forest Path.

3737.description:
The forest is thick here, and the light comes down in dim bars, grey and
green. Brambles tug at your sleeves along the path's edge, while the
trunks are wrapped in ivy like old bandages. A dead branch has fallen
across the trail and been trampled flat. The path runs north and south
through the wood.

3738.name: At A Turn On The Forest Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

east.description: To the east lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

3738.description:
The path turns sharply round a boulder furred with moss, which sits in
the middle of the trail like a sleeping head. Ferns spill over it in
untidy tufts, beaded with the day's mist. The air tastes of damp earth
and old leaves. A trail leads north through the trees, and the way east
returns toward the clearing.

3739.name: On A Path In The Dense Forest

east.description: To the east lies A Small Clearing.

west.description: To the west lies At A Turn On The Forest Path.

3739.description:
Here the path runs between two great hollow oaks, their trunks seamed
and black, their roots reaching across the track like fingers. A lone
grey feather has caught in a crack of bark and trembles without falling.
The leaf mould is deep and silent underfoot. The way east leads to a
clearing, and the path continues west.

3740.name: A Small Clearing

east.description: To the east lies Standing Before The Ruined Necropolis.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path In The Dense Forest.

3740.description:
A second small clearing opens among the trees, its grass bleached and
short as if grazed, though no beast has been this way. A flat stone lies
in the centre, round and worn, and mist gathers about it in a slow pool.
To the east the ruined necropolis shows its broken pillars through the
trunks, while west the forest path continues.

3741.name: Standing Before The Ruined Necropolis

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Ruined Temple.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Clearing.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Clearing.

down.description: To the down lies Path To The Underworld.

3741.description:
A broad court of cracked paving lies before a huge ruined necropolis,
its columns leaning and its steps strewn with fallen leaves. A great
bronze-bound door stands in the front wall, shut but not locked, with a
weathered lintel above it. A dark stair slopes down into the ground
beside the steps, and the clearings of the forest lie to either side,
east and west.

extra_descs.lintel inscription:
Worn letters on the lintel read, in an old script, that all who enter
are weighed and none are lost. Below them a carved feather has been
chipped half away.

3742.name: Entrance To The Ruined Temple

north.description: To the north lies A Small Antechamber.

east.description: To the east lies An Antechamber.

south.description: To the south lies Standing Before The Ruined Necropolis.

west.description: To the west lies An Antechamber.

3742.description:
This is a high bare hall, its flagstones scuffed by the feet of ages and
its pillars rising into shadow. Pale light leaks in through the doorway,
and the air is cool and utterly still. Doorways open on three sides, one
onto a small chamber ahead, others toward the antechambers east and
west. The great door stands behind you to the south.

3743.name: An Antechamber

north.description: To the north lies A Turning Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Ruined Temple.

west.description: To the west lies A Corner Chamber.

3743.description:
A broad antechamber, its walls ranked with shallow alcoves, each holding
a small stone figure of a seated judge with a feather in his hair. The
floor is checkered pale and dark, laid in neat squares. A pale light
spills from the great hall to the east, and a passage leads north, while
a door stands west.

3744.name: A Turning Corridor

south.description: To the south lies An Antechamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Turning Corridor.

3744.description:
The corridor turns here along a gentle arc, following the curve of some
great round room that lies hidden beyond the wall. Cold iron rings are
set into the stone at regular intervals, hung with the rotted remains of
rope. The only sounds are your steps and a faint drip. The passage runs
west, and back south to the antechamber.

3745.name: A Turning Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Turning Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Corner Chamber.

3745.description:
A turning in the corridor, where the floor dips slightly toward a drain
choked with grey sediment. The walls are bare and cold to the touch, and
the faint tang of copper hangs in the air. Someone has scratched a tally
of short vertical lines into the plaster, row upon row. East lies the
other half of the corridor, and south a door leads to a corner room.

3746.name: A Corner Chamber

north.description: To the north lies A Turning Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies An Antechamber.

3746.description:
A small square chamber where two heavy doors meet at a corner, a stone
lamp-stand between them. The ceiling is plain beams blackened by old
smoke, and the dust beneath your feet is deep and soft. A door opens
north into the turning corridor, and another stands east into the
antechamber.

3747.name: A Small Antechamber

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Ruined Temple.

3747.description:
A small stone room with a low ceiling, bare except for a stone bench
along the wall and a shallow niche where a lamp once burned. Dust lies
thick on everything, unmarked, and the silence presses on your ears. The
only way out is the doorway back to the entrance hall.

3748.name: An Antechamber

east.description: To the east lies A Corner Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Ruined Temple.

3748.description:
A square antechamber, its walls painted with faded figures walking in
procession, each carrying a small pair of scales. The paint has flaked
away from the faces and left only grey stone. A heavy door in the far
wall stands ajar to the east, and an open archway leads west back to the
entrance hall.

3749.name: A Corner Chamber

north.description: To the north lies A Winding Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies An Antechamber.

3749.description:
The room is a corner of the temple's passages, where two walls meet in a
tight angle and a lone stone urn stands in the fork. The floor has been
worn into a slight trough by countless slow steps. A door of black wood
leads north, and an archway returns west to the antechamber.

3750.name: A Winding Corridor

south.description: To the south lies A Corner Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Winding Corridor.

3750.description:
The corridor winds sharply here, its walls close enough to touch both at
once. Faint carvings of long-necked birds run along the stone at
shoulder height, their beaks all pointing the same way. A cold draught
moves along the floor. The passage goes west deeper into the temple, and
a door lies south.

3751.name: A Winding Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Winding Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies A Winding Corridor.

3751.description:
The passage bends again, and the old plaster has fallen from the walls
in leprous patches to show the grey blocks beneath. A single iron
bracket juts from the wall, empty, rimmed with soot. The floor slopes
subtly beneath your feet. You may follow the corridor north or turn back
east.

3752.name: A Winding Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Winding Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Winding Corridor.

3752.description:
A hush lies on this stretch of corridor so deep that your own breathing
seems intrusive. The ceiling is lower here and stained dark in lines, as
if water once ran in from above. Dry flakes of old reed matting crunch
underfoot. The way goes east along the winding passage, and south back
down it.

3753.name: A Winding Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Winding Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies A Winding Corridor.

3753.description:
Several long cracks run up the walls here, and through them you can feel
cold air from somewhere deeper. A bundle of dry reeds lies tied with
faded cord against the wall, an offering long forgotten, and its knots
have gone grey with dust. The corridor winds on north and returns west.

3754.name: A Winding Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Corner Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies A Winding Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Chamber.

3754.description:
Three passages meet in this dim junction, and the stone floor is
polished to a dull shine by the passing of countless slow feet. Wax
drippings have hardened in a thick crust below an iron sconce. A heavy
door stands shut to the north, another to the west, and the corridor you
came along winds back south.

3755.name: A Corner Chamber

south.description: To the south lies A Winding Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies A Straight Corridor.

3755.description:
A small chamber with walls of fitted blocks, bare and square, where the
air smells of cold ash and old stone. A shallow basin is set into the
floor, dry and rimmed with white crust. Ahead a low door leads west into
a straight corridor, and the passage you came by opens south.

3756.name: A Small Chamber

east.description: To the east lies A Winding Corridor.

3756.description:
A tiny cell of a room, hardly larger than a closet, with a stone ledge
running round three walls at the height of a seat. Tallow stains darken
the wall above each place, as though patient people once sat here and
waited. Nothing else remains. The only way out is the door east into the
junction.

3757.name: A Straight Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Corner Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Straight Corridor.

3757.description:
A long straight corridor runs on ahead, the roof held up by squat square
pillars set into the walls. Each pillar bears a faded red band, and the
bands blur toward the far end. Your footsteps return as thin echoes. The
passage goes west deeper in, and a doorway opens east into the small
chamber behind you.

3758.name: A Straight Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Straight Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies A Straight Corridor.

3758.description:
The corridor is dead straight and perfectly level here, and the light
from the entrance has long since given out. Chips of dark tile are
scattered across the floor, fragments of a mosaic that was prised up
long ago. A faint smell of myrrh lingers in the cold air. Straight
passage lies east and west of you.

3759.name: A Straight Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Straight Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies A Corner Chamber.

3759.description:
At this end of the long corridor the walls are cut with rows of small
square niches, every one empty and blackened inside. Fine grey dust lies
in them, soft as flour. The stillness has the quality of a held breath.
A door to the west leads on into a chamber, and the corridor runs back
east.

3760.name: A Corner Chamber

east.description: To the east lies A Straight Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Short Corridor.

3760.description:
A tight chamber where two passages meet at a right angle, the corner
ringed by a low stone curb. Painted on the wall is a faded figure with
the head of a bird, its beak raised as if to speak. The air is dry and
faintly sweet. A door in the wall leads south, and the straight corridor
lies east.

3761.name: A Short Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Corner Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies A Short Corridor.

3761.description:
A short corridor with a floor of rough black flags and walls hung with
old frayed cords that once held tablets. The ceiling is only just above
your head, and condensation gleams along it. Everything is very quiet.
The passage leads back north to the chamber and on south.

3762.name: A Short Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Short Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Oracle's Chamber.

3762.description:
The short corridor ends against a plain wall of sooty stone, its last
yard dressed with a row of seven small clay lamps, all cold. A carved
stone lintel arches over a doorway set in the east wall. You may go east
through it, or back north along the passage.

3763.name: The Oracle's Chamber

north.description: To the north lies A Twisting Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies A Short Corridor.

3763.description:
This round chamber is hung with grey curtains that stir though no breeze
moves, and a three-legged bronze stool stands in the centre over a crack
in the floor. The air is heavy with old incense, and a pale light seems
to come from nowhere in particular. A door stands in the north wall, and
the way west leads back into the short corridor.

extra_descs.stool bronze crack:
The bronze stool is three-legged, green with age, and stands squarely
over a crack in the floor from which a faint cold air seems to rise.
Whoever sat here once spoke for the dead.

3764.name: A Twisting Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Twisting Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Oracle's Chamber.

3764.description:
The corridor twists here like a stair that has lost its steps, bending
slowly left and then right between walls scored with spiral lines. A
trickle of damp has left a green stain down one side. Your own shadow
lengthens and shrinks as you pass the lamp-niches. The twisting passage
goes north, and south through a door to the chamber behind.

3765.name: A Twisting Corridor

east.description: To the east lies A Twisting Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Twisting Corridor.

3765.description:
The passage doubles back on itself in a slow curve, the grey walls
running with delicate carved vines that frame small faces, all worn
blank. A chill breath of air passes over your hands. Underfoot a few
tiles show a pattern of waves. East the twisting passage continues, and
south it winds back.

3766.name: A Twisting Corridor

south.description: To the south lies Aphrodite's Altar Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Twisting Corridor.

3766.description:
The last twist of the corridor ends in a narrow landing before a pair of
tall doors, their panels carved with doves and roses. Petals of dried
rose lie scattered on the floor, brown and brittle as paper. A sweet and
sorrowful scent clings to the air. The doors lead south, and the
corridor winds back west.

3767.name: Aphrodite's Altar Chamber

north.description: To the north lies A Twisting Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies At The Altar To Aphrodite.

3767.description:
An airy vaulted chamber, once beautiful, its walls painted in softened
pinks and golds that have gone chalky. Marble doves with broken wings
perch along a cornice, and a mosaic of a rising shell is half intact in
the floor. A sweet dust hangs in the air. Doors lead back north, and a
low archway opens south to the altar.

3768.name: At The Altar To Aphrodite

north.description: To the north lies Aphrodite's Altar Chamber.

3768.description:
A small shrine room, its walls hung with the grey remains of silk, and
in the centre a low altar of rose-veined marble heaped with withered
garlands. Black candle stubs stand in a ring about it, and a thin ash
lies in the offering bowl. It is tender, hushed, and utterly cold. The
only way out leads back north.

extra_descs.altar marble garlands:
The altar is carved from rose-veined marble, smooth as skin, and heaped
with garlands that crumble to powder when stirred. A line of faded words
runs round its edge, praising love that outlasts the grave.

3771.name: Path To The Underworld

north.description: To the north lies Before The River Styx.

up.description: To the up lies Standing Before The Ruined Necropolis.

3771.description:
A steep, narrow stair of worn stone drops from the forest above into the
rock, its steps hollowed by long use and damp with seeping water. The
air turns cold and still, and the light from above shrinks behind you to
a pale square. Rough walls close in on both sides, running with silver
threads of moisture. The stair leads up to the necropolis court, and the
passage runs on north.

3772.name: Before The River Styx

north.description: To the north lies Before The Gates Of Hades.

south.description: To the south lies Path To The Underworld.

3772.description:
The tunnel opens onto a broad ledge of black rock above a wide
underground river, whose slow oily water slides past in the dark. The
far bank cannot be seen, and a faint wind blows off the water bringing
the smell of cold iron. A narrow ledge of stone follows the bank north
toward a wharf, and the way back leads south up the passage.

3773.name: Crossing The River Styx

south.description: To the south lies Before The River Styx.

3773.description:
You are afloat on the Styx, a wide black river that moves without sound,
its surface smooth as polished slate. No stars, no reflections, only the
dim luminous edge of the water on either side of the boat. Cold bites at
your fingers whenever they stray near the rail. Behind you the near bank
lies south, a pale smudge of stone on the dark.

3774.name: Before The Gates Of Hades

north.description: To the north lies At The Gates Of Hades.

south.description: To the south lies Crossing The River Styx.

3774.description:
A wharf of black stone juts out into the river, its edge worn into
scallops by countless ferry-hulls, a mooring ring still set into it.
Beyond is a wide stair rising to a pair of towering gates, their tops
lost in gloom. Cold water laps softly against the stone below, and the
way south leads out onto the Styx. The gates lie north.

3775.name: At The Gates Of Hades

north.description: To the north lies In The Underworld.

south.description: To the south lies Before The Gates Of Hades.

3775.description:
Two vast gates of dark metal stand before you, each leaf wrought with
writhing figures that seem to stir when you look away. The floor is
polished stone laid in squares, scattered with the dull glint of old
coin. The air is thick and utterly still. A door in the gates lies ajar
north, and the wharf stair lies south.

3776.name: In The Underworld

north.description: To the north lies Before The Gates To Tartarus.

south.description: To the south lies At The Gates Of Hades.

3776.description:
A vast cavern, grey and dim, stretches around you with a roof lost in
shadow. Pale shapes drift along the rock without ever quite arriving,
and the air is cold and faintly sweet. Distant murmurs rise and fall
like a crowd that has forgotten its words. Beyond lie more gates north,
and the great doors south.

3777.name: Before The Gates To Tartarus

north.description: To the north lies A White Gate.

east.description: To the east lies The Waiting Room Of The Doomed.

south.description: To the south lies In The Underworld.

3777.description:
Three ways divide here before a tall archway, with a tall black spear of
stone standing sentinel in the middle of the floor. Beyond the arch to
the north rise the grim gates to Tartarus, white, grey and black. A door
opens east to a long low room where voices murmur. The path south
returns to the cavern, with its pale drifting shapes.

3778.name: The Waiting Room Of The Doomed

north.description: To the north lies A Judge's Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies A Judge's Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies A Judge's Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies Before The Gates To Tartarus.

3778.description:
A broad stone hall filled with low benches of grey slab, their seats
worn into hollows by the dead who have sat here waiting. A single dim
lamp hangs from a chain and sways with no wind. Four doorways open from
it, each marked by a pair of carved scales: west to the gates, and
chambers lying north, east and south.

3779.name: A Judge's Chamber

south.description: To the south lies The Waiting Room Of The Doomed.

3779.description:
A high chamber of pale stone, its far wall hung with a huge balance
whose pans of beaten gold hang level and still. A long bench stands
empty before it, and a quill lies abandoned on a writing-desk, its ink
long dried. The room smells of dust and parchment. The only exit is
south, back to the waiting room.

extra_descs.balance scales pans gold:
The great balance hangs from a bronze beam, its pans of beaten gold
hanging level though nothing rests in either. A small feather is cast
into the base, as the standard against which all hearts are weighed.

3780.name: A Judge's Chamber

west.description: To the west lies The Waiting Room Of The Doomed.

3780.description:
A narrow chamber dominated by a great seat of bone and black wood set
high on a dais, its arms carved to the likeness of folded wings. Rows of
empty benches face it in tiers. A single beam of grey light falls from a
high crack onto the dais. The way out lies west to the waiting room.

3781.name: A Judge's Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Waiting Room Of The Doomed.

3781.description:
A low-ceilinged judge's room, its walls lined with ledgers bound in grey
hide, shelf upon shelf of them, each spine bearing a name. A long table
stands in the middle, spread with a black cloth. A feather of white and
a feather of black lie crossed on its surface. The room opens north into
the waiting hall.

3782.name: A White Gate

north.description: To the north lies A Gray Gate.

south.description: To the south lies Before The Gates To Tartarus.

3782.description:
A tall gate of white marble stands in an arch of polished stone, its two
leaves carved with pale rows of laurel leaves. Light from nowhere falls
on it evenly, and not a speck of dust lies on the floor. It feels like a
place for the blameless. The way south returns to the archway, and a
door leads north to the next gate.

3783.name: A Gray Gate

north.description: To the north lies A Black Gate.

south.description: To the south lies A White Gate.

3783.description:
The gate of grey stone is neither fair nor foul, a heavy arch of
weathered slate carved with an endless pattern of woven reeds. The floor
is the colour of ash, and the air has a neutral, waiting chill. A small
stone bench stands against the wall for those who cannot decide. A door
leads north, and the white gate lies south.

3784.name: A Black Gate

north.description: To the north lies The Path to Tartarus.

south.description: To the south lies A Gray Gate.

3784.description:
A gate of black iron towers here, its bars as thick as a man's arm and
wrought into the shape of folded wings. Cold wells up from the floor,
and the stone around the arch is scorched and cracked. A smell of old
smoke and hot metal drifts down from the passage beyond. A door leads
north toward Tartarus, and the grey gate lies south.

3785.name: The Path to Tartarus

south.description: To the south lies A Black Gate.

down.description: To the down lies Bottom of a Hill in Tartarus.

3785.description:
A narrow stone path winds away from the black gate along the top of a
steep slope, with no wall to either side and only a dark and silent
drop. The rock underfoot is rough and cracked, and warm air rises from
below with a faint stink of brimstone. A rail of old chain follows the
edge. The path slopes down into Tartarus, while south it returns to the
gate.

3786.name: Bottom of a Hill in Tartarus

south.description: To the south lies Beside The River Lethe.

up.description: To the up lies The Path to Tartarus.

3786.description:
You stand at the foot of a bleak hill of loose black shale, where
nothing grows and the air is heavy and thick. Rills of slow, tarry water
gather in the hollows. A faint wail drifts across the slope, rising and
falling, and never comes any closer. A path leads back up the hill, and
the way south descends toward a river.

3787.name: Beside The River Lethe

north.description: To the north lies Bottom of a Hill in Tartarus.

south.description: To the south lies Along A Garden Path.

3787.description:
A wide dark river flows past in silence here, between banks of smooth
grey stones, its surface lapping soundlessly. Pale flowers of poppy grow
in the cracks, nodding in a breath of air. A sweet drowsiness steals
over you, and the thoughts of the living world grow faint. The path
leads north up toward the hill, and south onto a garden walk.

3788.name: Along A Garden Path

north.description: To the north lies Beside The River Lethe.

east.description: To the east lies The Garden Of Everlasting Peace.

south.description: To the south lies Facing a Fury.

west.description: To the west lies The Garden Of Everlasting Peace.

3788.description:
A paved garden walk runs between low hedges of grey-green yew, each
trimmed square and neat, and the light is like an even dusk. Small cold
flowers blossom along the border, white and unscented. Doors of pale
wood stand to east and west, leading into the garden proper, and another
passage runs south through a heavy arch of black stone. The path returns
north to the river.

3789.name: The Garden Of Everlasting Peace

east.description: To the east lies Along A Garden Path.

3789.description:
The Garden of Everlasting Peace spreads out in terraces of soft turf and
beds of pale blossom, each flower perfect and cold to the touch. A
winding stream runs through it in a bed of white pebbles, and a marble
bench waits beside it. It is peaceful in the way of a held breath. The
door east leads back out to the garden path.

3790.name: The Garden Of Everlasting Peace

west.description: To the west lies Along A Garden Path.

3790.description:
Here is the Garden of Everlasting Peace, a vast round lawn of silver
grass ringed with slender white trees whose leaves never fall. A shallow
pool lies in the centre, perfectly clear, reflecting a sky that is not
there. Everything is still and bright and lovely, yet no bird sings and
no wind stirs. The door west leads back to the garden path.

extra_descs.pool clear water:
The pool is clear to its bed of white pebbles, and no ripple ever
crosses it. Its surface shows a blue sky and a drifting white cloud,
though no sky can be seen above.

3791.name: Facing a Fury

north.description: To the north lies Along A Garden Path.

south.description: To the south lies Trials Of The Underworld - Facing A Fury.

3791.description:
The passage is a long hall of dark scorched stone, its walls carved with
the figures of three winged women in torment, mouths open in silent
screams. Whips of braided bronze hang from iron hooks beside each. The
air is hot and tastes of blood. The path runs north back to the garden
and south through the trial.

3792.name: Trials Of The Underworld - Facing A Fury

north.description: To the north lies Facing a Fury.

south.description: To the south lies Trials Of The Underworld - Facing A Fury.

3792.description:
Deep gashes mark the walls of this trial hall, as if great claws had
raked them over and over. A pair of tall braziers stand cold, ringed
with ash, and the floor is dark with old stains. The noise of distant
shrieking seems to come from the stone. You can go north toward the
entrance or south deeper into the trial.

3793.name: Trials Of The Underworld - Facing A Fury

north.description: To the north lies Trials Of The Underworld - Facing A Fury.

south.description: To the south lies A Fiery Door.

3793.description:
Chains hang in swags from the ceiling here, and each link is carved with
a tiny and terrible face. The floor is hot underfoot, and sparks
sometimes crackle among the rusted iron. Somewhere beyond, wings beat
slowly in the dark. The hall leads north back toward the first trial and
south to a fiery door.

3794.name: A Fiery Door

north.description: To the north lies Trials Of The Underworld - Facing A Fury.

south.description: To the south lies An Icy Door.

3794.description:
A massive door of red-hot bronze fills the south wall, its surface
rippling with heat and its handle glowing like an ember. The stones of
the floor glow faintly orange at the cracks. Sweat runs down your face
in moments. The passage lies north, and the door south opens to a colder
room.

3795.name: An Icy Door

north.description: To the north lies A Fiery Door.

south.description: To the south lies A Misty Door.

3795.description:
A door of blue-white ice fills the south wall, its panels clouded and
rimed with frost so thick it hides what lies behind. The room is
bitterly cold, the breath freezing in your beard, and frozen crystals
sparkle on every stone. Your fingers ache. The door south opens to a
misty room, and the fiery door lies north.

3796.name: A Misty Door

north.description: To the north lies An Icy Door.

south.description: To the south lies The Throne Room Of Hades.

3796.description:
A door of thick grey vapour hangs in the south wall, shifting and
curling like a living thing. The floor is damp and slick, and every
sound comes back muffled, as if heard through wet wool. You can see no
more than an arm's length. The vapour opens south onto the throne room,
and the cold door is north.

3797.name: The Throne Room Of Hades

north.description: To the north lies A Misty Door.

east.description: To the east lies Before An Onyx Throne.

west.description: To the west lies Before An Onyx Throne.

3797.description:
A mighty hall opens here, its pillars of black marble climbing into a
roof lost in darkness. Rows of torches burn with a cold green flame that
casts no warmth. At the far end, between the pillars, the floor rises
toward great seats, and the air is heavy with authority. A mist-door
leads north, and the hall continues east and west before the thrones.

3798.name: Before An Onyx Throne

east.description: To the east lies The Throne Room Of Hades.

3798.description:
A second dais of black onyx stands here, narrower than its twin and set
with a lesser throne, its high back inlaid with a pomegranate in veins
of garnet. A cloak of dark wool lies draped across the seat, and its
folds are stiff with dust. Pale seeds are scattered on the step. The
only way out lies east to the hall.

extra_descs.pomegranate throne garnet:
The pomegranate is inlaid in garnet and split to show its seeds, each
seed a tiny polished stone. It is the queen's chair, and the dust upon
it is thin.

3799.name: Before An Onyx Throne

west.description: To the west lies The Throne Room Of Hades.

3799.description:
A wide dais of black onyx rises here, polished to a mirror, with a
towering throne carved from one huge block of glittering stone. The arms
are worked into the shapes of hounds, their eyes set with dull red gems.
Cold seems to pour from the seat. You may only go back west toward the
hall.

649500.name: shade ghost drowned grey
649500.long_desc: A drowned shade drifts above the tideline, water streaming from its grey and weeping face.
649500.description:
The shade is a pale shape of a man long lost to the sea, his clothes
still dripping onto stones that never get wet. His hollow eyes look past
you toward the water, and his mouth works in silent apology.

649501.name: raven carrion grey bird
649501.long_desc: A grey carrion raven sits hunched on a dead bough, watching you with one pitiless eye.
649501.description:
Its feathers are the colour of ash, ragged at the edges, and its beak is
stained dark. It cocks its head at every step you take, as if counting,
and weighs you with a patient and unfriendly stare.

649502.name: skeleton temple warden bones
649502.long_desc: A temple skeleton stands rigid in the passage, a corroded bronze spear clutched in its bony hands.
649502.description:
The bones are yellow with age and bound by nothing but old magic, and a
scrap of grey linen still hangs from its ribs. Its empty sockets turn to
follow you as you move.

649503.name: fury winged harpy
649503.long_desc: A winged fury screams from the shadows, her bronze whip trailing from her taloned fist.
649503.description:
She is a gaunt woman with the wings of a vast bat and eyes like heated
coals, her hair a mass of writhing serpents. Her whip is bronze and ends
in barbs, and she holds it like one who has used it for ages.

649504.name: guard gate sentinel bronze-helmed
649504.long_desc: A bronze-helmed gate guard stands grimly before the arch, its shield raised and its pale eyes unblinking.
649504.description:
Beneath the helm is a face of grey, withered skin drawn tight over the
bone, and its mail has long since fused to the body. It does not
breathe, and it does not move unless you try to pass.

649505.name: charon ferryman boatman
649505.long_desc: Charon the Ferryman leans on his long black pole at the end of the wharf, a hooded and silent figure.
649505.description:
Charon is old beyond reckoning, his beard a tangled grey cloud and his
eyes like two sunken coals under his hood. He holds a long pole of black
wood and speaks to no one without payment, and his patience has run out
for those who bring none.

649506.name: judge dead weigher
649506.long_desc: The Judge of the Dead sits in perfect stillness before the scales, weighing you with his gaze.
649506.description:
He is a tall figure in a robe of grey feathers, his head that of a long-
beaked bird and his eyes bright and cold as stars. One hand rests on a
golden balance, and in the other he holds a single white feather.
Whatever you are, he already knows.

749500.name: grey feather truth
749500.short_desc: a grey feather of the dead
749500.room_desc: A long grey feather lies here, perfectly still.
749500.description: It is a long feather of soft ash-grey, unnaturally light, and whatever bird it came from has not flown in an age. Collectors of the strange pay well for such things.

749501.name: pole ferryman black staff
749501.room_desc: A long black ferryman's pole lies here.
749501.description: A pole of black wood, nearly twice a man's height and cold to hold. Its tip is iron-shod and worn bright from pushing off the bed of the Styx.

749502.name: shield bronze sentinel round
749502.room_desc: A dented bronze shield lies here.
749502.description: A round shield of corroded bronze, its face dented by many blows and its rim stamped with a pattern of scales. It is heavy but sound.

749503.name: whip bronze barbed fury
749503.room_desc: A barbed bronze whip lies here, coiled like a snake.
749503.description: A whip of braided bronze wire, tipped with small hooked barbs. It is horribly supple in the hand and seems to hunger for someone to wield it on.

749504.name: pall feather cloak grey judge
749504.room_desc: A pall of grey feathers lies here, light as breath.
749504.description: A mantle sewn from thousands of grey feathers, overlapping like scales and weighing nothing at all. It hangs about the shoulders with a grave, quiet dignity.
